name: mcp-harness
title: A company's year through the submission MCP
description: A scripted conversation in the local chat harness. Each tool turn is a real MCP tool call against the running server: a VAT return, a look at the VAT account, and the year's accounts.

steps.caption: A chat app reaches the submission server with one command or one web address.
steps.headline: One command to connect

steps.caption: This is the command for Claude Code.
steps.headline: The Claude Code command

steps.caption: The person asks for this quarter's VAT return and the year's accounts.
steps.headline: The request

steps.caption: Claude says what it will do.
steps.headline: Claude plans the calls

steps.caption: Claude opens the company's book on disk.
steps.headline: Open the book

steps.label: book
steps.caption: The server reports the book it opened.
steps.headline: The book is open

steps.caption: The book is Precision Code Ltd's year, 736 lines.
steps.headline: The company's book

steps.caption: Claude works out the VAT boxes from the book.
steps.headline: Work out the boxes

steps.label: derived
steps.caption: The nine boxes come from the book's own figures.
steps.headline: The nine boxes

steps.caption: Box 5 is the net VAT due, worked out by the accounting engine.
steps.headline: Net VAT due

steps.caption: Claude asks for HMRC's permission link.
steps.headline: Ask for permission

steps.label: authorise
steps.caption: The server answers with a link, not a token.
steps.headline: A link, not a token

steps.caption: Claude tells the person what to do.
steps.headline: Claude explains

steps.caption: The link opens HMRC's permission page beside the chat.
steps.headline: HMRC's page opens

target.name: Sign in to the HMRC online service

steps.caption: The person signs in to the HMRC online service.
steps.headline: Sign in to HMRC

steps.caption: The sandbox user id.
steps.headline: HMRC user id

steps.caption: The sandbox password.
steps.headline: HMRC password

steps.caption: HMRC asks whether to give Submit permission.
steps.headline: Sign in

steps.caption: The person gives permission.
steps.headline: Give permission

steps.label: the frame
steps.caption: Submit keeps HMRC's token. It never passes through the chat.
steps.headline: The token stays put

steps.caption: Claude lists the obligations HMRC holds.
steps.headline: List the obligations

steps.label: obligations
steps.caption: HMRC lists the open obligations.
steps.headline: Open obligations

steps.caption: Claude shows the boxes and asks for a yes.
steps.headline: Claude asks first

steps.caption: Once the person says yes, Claude files the return.
steps.headline: File the return

steps.label: filed
steps.caption: HMRC accepts the return and the server answers with its receipt.
steps.headline: HMRC accepts it

steps.caption: The receipt id and period key come back in the answer.
steps.headline: The receipt

steps.caption: Claude fetches the stored receipt.
steps.headline: Fetch the receipt

steps.label: receipt
steps.caption: The stored receipt is the record of the filing.
steps.headline: The stored receipt

steps.caption: Next the person wants to know where the account stands.
steps.headline: The account

steps.caption: What does HMRC say the business owes?
steps.headline: What is owed

steps.label: liabilities
steps.caption: HMRC lists the liabilities.
steps.headline: The liabilities

steps.caption: What has been paid?
steps.headline: What is paid

steps.label: payments
steps.caption: HMRC lists the payments it has received.
steps.headline: The payments

steps.caption: What did an earlier return say?
steps.headline: A past return

steps.label: pastReturn
steps.caption: HMRC gives back the filed return.
steps.headline: The return, as filed

steps.caption: The return is read back from HMRC, not from our own copy.
steps.headline: Read back from HMRC

steps.caption: Then the year's accounts, from the same book.
steps.headline: The accounts

steps.caption: Claude works out the balance sheet lines.
steps.headline: The balance sheet

steps.label: accountsFigures
steps.caption: The seven balance sheet lines, this year and last.
steps.headline: The seven lines

steps.caption: Claude asks for a link to type the Companies House code.
steps.headline: Ask for the code link

steps.label: codes
steps.caption: The server answers with a link.
steps.headline: A link for the code

steps.caption: Claude tells the person what to do.
steps.headline: Claude explains

steps.caption: The person types the company's authentication code on the page, not in the chat.
steps.headline: The code goes on the page

steps.caption: Saving the code puts it behind the link.
steps.headline: Save the code

steps.caption: Claude files the accounts with the Companies House test service.
steps.headline: File the accounts

steps.label: accountsFiled
steps.caption: The gateway gives a submission number.
steps.headline: A submission number

steps.caption: Claude asks whether Companies House accepted them.
steps.headline: Were they accepted

steps.label: accountsOutcome
steps.caption: Companies House reports the outcome.
steps.headline: The outcome

steps.caption: Companies House's test service reports the filing as pending.
steps.headline: Pending at Companies House

steps.caption: Claude sums up.
steps.headline: The summary
